annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication from the Commission – Industrial Action Plan for the European automotive sector (COM(2025) 95 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication from the Commission – Industrial Action Plan for the European automotive sector (COM(2025) 95 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
named_instruments_referenced: Industrial Action Plan for the European automotive sector
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on the Commission's Industrial Action Plan for the automotive sector. It backs a fair, competitive transition covering EVs, skills, supply chains and trade. It includes a section on connected and autonomous vehicles, calling for a harmonised regulatory framework, liability clarity and a type-approval timeline.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for harmonised standards and regulation for connected and autonomous vehicles to support testing and deployment.
Seeks legal certainty on liability in autonomous vehicle accidents.
Calls for a harmonised approach and clear timeline for type-approval of autonomous vehicles.
Proposes a European Connected and Autonomous Vehicle Alliance and an Auto Data Act.
Urges reskilling programmes, social dialogue and support for regions and SMEs.
